snippet.title: Space Savory - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Savory launches on Steam on October 26, 2026.
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760770/Space_Savory/

Space Savory is a hand-drawn, darkly comedic cooking game set in a suspicious roadside diner in the middle of cosmic nothingness.
After crash-landing on an unknown planet, a stranded astronaut must earn enough money to buy fuel and find a way back home. Unfortunately for the customers, they also happen to be the source of the ingredients you need.
Abduct strange aliens, collect what’s inside them, and prepare bizarre meals, desserts, and drinks through a variety of cooking mini-games. Serve your creations back to hungry customers, meet unusual characters, manage your inventory, gamble with shady space-flies, report wanted criminals, survive pirate attacks, and more.
Developed and published by DelusionArt Studio.
